request: Harden durable-plan slug path handling: reject a non-kebab-case slug before any path is constructed (plan-store.planPath, checker-fanout.persistVerdict), and make the durable-plan mirror unable to fail-open the live gate-A verdict path.
novelty_evidence: Backlog entry durable-plan-slug-path-traversal-hardening-7c4d (status: open, raised 2026-06-22, estimated-effort: small) prescribes the guard contract verbatim; findings at docs/archive/2026-06-22/durable-plan-schema/security.md (MEDIUM CWE-22 + LOW). Both defects confirmed on disk: plan-store.mjs:12-13 joins an unvalidated slug into .claude/state/plan/<slug>.json; checker-fanout.mjs:57 builds .claude/state/checker-fanout/<slug>.json the same way; checker-fanout.mjs:61 calls mirrorVerdictToPlan outside any try/catch.
